stem.en: Which statement best expresses the writer's main point?

options.en: Doing something with no pressure to succeed can change how we approach our strengths.
If we keep practising something we are bad at, we will slowly become good at it.
We learn best when we keep comparing our own progress with the progress of others.
Students who are good at maths should take up music as a way to help them relax.

why.en: Singing with no reputation to protect freed the writer from thinking about results, and this changed how they approach maths. The writer expects to stay a weak singer, does not praise comparing yourself with others and does not recommend music in particular.
why.uz: Hech qanday obroʻni himoya qilish shart boʻlmagan qoʻshiq muallifni natija haqida oʻylashdan ozod qildi va bu uning matematikaga yondashuvini oʻzgartirdi. Muallif kuchsiz xonanda boʻlib qolishini kutadi, oʻzini boshqalar bilan solishtirishni maqtamaydi va aynan musiqani tavsiya qilmaydi.
why.ru: Пение, где не нужно защищать репутацию, освободило автора от мыслей о результате, и это изменило его подход к математике. Автор ожидает, что так и останется слабым певцом, не хвалит сравнение себя с другими и не советует именно музыку.

stem.en: What does the father's reaction show about his attitude to Javlon's plan?

options.en: He supports it, although he does not say so directly.
He supports it, and he tells Javlon how proud he is of him.
He is worried, and he warns Javlon that he is making a mistake.
He is against it, but he does not want to argue in the shop.

why.en: Instead of arguing, he gives Javlon the tools his own teacher gave him when he left home, so he supports the plan without saying so. He never says he is proud, and 'Everyone told me I was making a mistake' is about his own past, not a warning.
why.uz: U bahslashish oʻrniga Javlonga oʻzi uydan ketayotganda ustozi bergan asboblarni beradi, demak rejani ochiq aytmasa ham qoʻllab-quvvatlaydi. U hech qachon faxrlanishini aytmaydi, 'Hamma menga xato qilyapsan degan edi' esa ogohlantirish emas, uning oʻz oʻtmishi haqida.
why.ru: Вместо спора он отдаёт Жавлону инструменты, которые ему самому подарил учитель, когда он уезжал из дома, то есть поддерживает план, не говоря об этом прямо. Он не говорит, что гордится сыном, а «Все говорили мне, что я совершаю ошибку» — о его собственном прошлом, а не предупреждение.
